# OmniFeed — Library Features Specification
*(Generated by /architect & /pm)*

## 1. Vision & Goals
Evolve OmniFeed from a transient content aggregator into a persistent **personal content library**. Users will not only collect content from various platforms but also actively organize, track, revisit, and manage it over time without the clutter of a standard "inbox".

## 2. Core Entities & Data Modeling (Architecture)

### 2.1 Collections
- **Definition**: User-defined lists (e.g., Active, Courses, Career, AI, Watch Later).
- **Data Model**: `collections` sub-collection under the user document in Firestore.
  - `id`: string
  - `name`: string
  - `createdAt`: timestamp
  - `resurfaceConfig`: object (optional, for Scheduled Resurfacing)
- **Relationships**: Content items maintain an array of `collectionIds`.

### 2.2 Content Status
- **States**: `New`, `Saved`, `Active`, `Completed`.
- **Implementation**: Tracked in the `user_content_interactions` sub-collection.
  - `status`: enum
  - `statusUpdatedAt`: timestamp

### 2.3 Series Tracking
- **Definition**: Grouping related content into a sequential series.
- **Data Model**: `series` document tracking progress.
  - `title`: string
  - `totalItems`: number
  - `completedItems`: number
  - `nextItemId`: string

### 2.4 Rich Content Metadata (Normalized)
- Content stored in Firestore must be platform-agnostic to support library search and unified filtering.
- **Fields**:
  - `title`, `author`, `sourcePlatform`, `sourceUrl`, `contentType`, `publicationDate`, `duration`, `thumbnail`.

## 3. UI/UX Architecture

### 3.1 1-Page Clean Layout (Apple Podcasts/Overcast Inspiration)
- **Navigation**: Separation between:
  - **My Feed**: Current incoming content (plus resurfaced items).
  - **Collections**: Organized, intentionally kept content.
  - **Completed**: Archive of finished content.
  - **Bookmarks**: Quick-save staging area.
- **Clutter Reduction**:
  - Remove explicit `isRead` toggles and "grayed out" read states.
  - Remove arbitrary `limitPerSource` filters.
  - Content flows chronologically; if the user doesn't save it, it naturally falls out of view.

### 4. Technical Phasing (Superpowers Execution)

**Phase 1: UI Cleanup & Architecture Prep**
- Remove `isRead` and `limitPerSource` from UI and state.
- Adopt a cleaner 1-page layout for the main feed.

**Phase 2: Data Model Migration (TDD)**
- Write failing tests for Firebase interaction (`status` and `collections`).
- Implement the `user_content_interactions` model in Firestore rules and admin SDK.

**Phase 3: Library UI Implementation**
- Build the Collections, Series, and Archive views.
